speaker: john_heminges
text: The king this afternoon. You are Gaunt. You are done when the second act is done.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The second act. The jaw is whole. I am not asking for more of the play than the book has.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: The book as we play it. Nothing put back. The join stands where the Master left it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then we run the join, and we go to dinner. I am not rehearsing a scene that is not in the book.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nor I. Gaunt dies. The rest of the king is yours, from the door.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: From the door, as it has been. I do not need a new page to get from his death to the end.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Nine of the clock was for the join. It is joined. Eat.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will eat. I will not call it the sixth until it has been the sixth.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Call it after. The house is not in yet.
